text: APPROVE: the extraction moves the three loops into helpers in the same order (template sites, style-object sites, animate calls), so behaviour is unchanged and `InScript` is left with only a few simple branches, well under 15. I couldn't check the helper parameter types (`IReadOnlySet<string>` for `guards`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string,bool>` for `keyframes`) against the real signatures, so the clean build is assumed rather than confirmed.
